title: Department of Energy manages UFO secrecy and crash retrievals

tellings.quote: think and kind of know that the Department of Energy has a lot to do with managing UFO secrecy and crash retrievals.

plain: Jesse Michels says that people who follow the subject think, and more or less know, that the US Department of Energy plays a large part in keeping UFOs secret and in recovering crashed craft. He says this himself and does not name a source. If it were true, the agency would be one of the main keepers of the secret.
